task_description: Full-site visual redesign of the Demaze Technologies Next.js 16 App Router website, porting the provided static HTML prototype (Document 1) into idiomatic App Router surfaces: DM Sans + Space Grotesk fonts, an oklch color system, a scroll-progress + sticky-header chrome shell, reworked Nav and Footer, a shared reduced-motion/no-JS-safe client motion module (reveal, count-up, hero parallax, services sticky-stage, img parallax), and rebuilt home/projects/services/about-us/contact-us pages matching the prototype's layout, copy, color, typography, spacing, components and interactions. All missing prototype assets are substituted with reused existing files, inline-SVG or CSS-gradient placeholders (never dead srcs). Committed directly to main; no PR. Document 2 (7shifts) informs patterns/radii/spacing only; the prototype's pink oklch palette wins on concrete values.
